title: AUM: fast facts and bounded readiness
subtitle: P71: identity gates scoped HTTP data, not independent Azure-authorized Direct facts. No automatic paid start or authority fallback.

nodes.title: One read cycle
lines: [[tokens]]: one acquisition per resource and context
One bridge snapshot; current write preflight is never cached
Independent telemetry queries overlap

nodes.title: Existing sources, unchanged accounting
lines: [[bridge]] lists nonsecret named values once
Shared catalog, tiers and token/USD converters
Log Analytics: request-time ledger and priced workspace facts
A new cycle or any write invalidates the snapshot

nodes.title: Current data, source by source
lines: [[progress]] paints each completed source
Named waits, estimates and elapsed time; settings remain usable
Optional failures stay visible beside successful reads
Identity still gates edits; superseded reads cannot repaint

nodes.title: Authenticated identity is readiness
lines: GET [[auth-me]] with a short timeout
Azure credential may load concurrently in memory
A healthy /health alone does not establish database readiness

nodes.title: Timeout or 5xx: read-only ARM diagnosis
lines: [[diagnose]] uses the recorded deployment group
The integration must match the selected origin and scope
Exactly one validated PostgreSQL server; observed state only
No redirects, connection strings or resource writes

nodes.title: An explicit reason, not an automatic action
lines: Stopped: exit 9, server name and manual paid start command
Unverified, Ready or ambiguous: exit 7 with the limit stated
401 / 403 remain authentication / scope errors
The client never starts the database or changes authority

notice: Server state is a read-time observation. A single-server group is the recorded U35 deployment assumption, not a verified connection-string association. Token expiry, read snapshots, authorization, ingestion and gateway enforcement are separate facts.
